Author: Monk Layout contributors
Name: Monk Layout
Punchline: Apply and restore a level 100 Monk HUD and keyboard hotbars.
Description: One-time setup for a level 100 Monk on keyboard and mouse. Builds HUD 4, fills Monk hotbars 1-3 and optionally sets keyboard bindings. Keeps a local backup and offers Restore. Open with /monklayout.
Changelog: Save the live HUD before checking saved hotbar entries. Fix the premature missing _ActionBar error and allow restoring a backup even when the current HUD is incomplete. Retain active-character Monk detection from 1.1.1.0.
